Results.ReviewText: I ordered the Weber Master Touch Kettle Grill in Deep Ocean Blue online from the Home Depot on May 8 for my husband for Father’s Day. When I got it the box was double taped, I didn’t think anything of it. The ash catcher holder was so bent it wouldn’t stay on, and the lid was bent and scratched up. I contacted Weber online and sent the pictures and proof of purchase, they sent me a new one touch circle ash catcher, and then the new lid. The new lid came in worse shape than the original one, the box was pretty smashed and when I opened it the lid was shaped like an oval! We haven’t even got to use it yet. They say they are out of the lids and will send one when they are back in stock. I’m ready to take the grill back to Home Depot for a refund!
Results.Title: Arrived with damaged lid and one touch ash holder

Results.ReviewText:
As a first-time kettle grill owner, I did my research and landed on the Weber 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill in Deep Ocean Blue — and I couldn’t be happier with the decision. Weber’s reputation in the grilling world is well-earned, and this grill backs it up.

Appearance

The Deep Ocean Blue finish is stunning. It stands out from the standard black kettle grills you see everywhere and adds a real personality to your backyard setup. It’s the kind of grill that draws compliments before you even fire it up.

Setup & Ease of Use

Assembly is straightforward and well thought out. Everything fits together cleanly, and the instructions are clear enough that you won’t be scratching your head for long. For a first-time charcoal griller, that confidence boost right out of the box matters.

Temperature Control

The damper vent system gives you solid control over airflow and heat management. There’s a natural learning curve to dialing in your ideal cooking temperature, but the system is logical — adjust the vents, monitor the heat, and fine-tune from there. After a cook or two, it starts to feel very intuitive.

Lid Holder

The built-in lid holder on the bowl is a genuinely useful feature, keeping the lid secure and out of your way while you tend to the fire or manage your food. One word of caution though — sliding the lid in and out of the holder can scratch the paint over time. If keeping that beautiful Deep Ocean Blue finish in perfect condition is important to you, handle it with a little extra care.

Bottom Line

The Weber Master-Touch is a fantastic entry point into charcoal grilling. It’s well-built, easy to get started with, and comes from a brand that has been trusted for decades. Minor paint scuffing aside, this grill checks every box. Highly recommended.
Results.Title: An Excellent First Kettle Grill That Delivers.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
